finding: BOTH builders compute prior_score as count(key_N over ALL rows) / count(key_D over ALL rows) with key_N != key_D and no restriction of the numerator to the denominator's key. SLURP's ratio is a conditional probability only because intent = f'{scenario}_{action}' nests intent inside scenario in the LABEL VOCABULARY; the local name 'intent_total_in_scenario' asserts a restriction the expression does not perform. The SLURP builder therefore carries the identical latent defect and would break exactly as the A2T builder did under a non-nesting label scheme.
